title: A line saved before this change opens with the same title and description
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a work order made before this release, work order 1, with a line, line 1, that has a title and a description.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Line window opens for line 1.
  • The Title box shows exactly the title line 1 shows on work order 1's Lines tab, character for character, under the label "Title".
  • The Description box shows exactly line 1's description, under the label "Description".
  • Neither value has "What are you doing?", "Why are you doing it?" or any other words added in front of it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-N1: “No existing line is altered. The rename is on the labels, not on the data.”
  • S1-R7: “Nothing else about the dialog changes, other than the label position in S1-R3: same fields in the same order, same validation, same values saved.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “Nothing about the values changes: same fields, same storage, same customer documents.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
